title: Chris Brazzell’s rookie season over before it even began

sources.title: Chris Brazzell’s rookie season over before it even began
sources.description: NFL training camps are a tough place where brutal injuries can derail seasons just as they’re getting started. That’s been particularly the case this year in Charlotte, where the Carolina Panthers have had a pair of brutal losses to young players, including former Tennessee Vols WR Chris Brazzell II.
